findings.title: Styler closure captures loop variable and record
findings.message: The page styler is installed once per page and closes over the loop variable `id` and the record `r`. If the page widget is reused for a different record or a page ID is remapped, the styler would still use the stale `r`. The `id` capture is safe only when the module targets Go 1.22 or later. On earlier versions all stylers share the final `id`, so ribbon pages get the wrong styling.
findings.suggestion: Copy the loop variable (`id := id`) before the closure. Also resolve the node from the page's current descriptor rather than capturing `r`, or verify that `r` is stable for the page's lifetime.
